content.text: I will … teach thee what thou shalt say, Ex. 4:12. thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, Ex. 18:20. that ye may teach the children of Israel, Lev. 10:11. I have taught you statutes and judgments, Deut. 4:5. teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons, Deut. 4:9. thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, Deut. 6:7 (11:19). ye shall let your children know, Josh. 4:22 (4:8, 20–24). I will teach you the good and the right way, 1 Sam. 12:23. teach them the good way, 1 Kgs. 8:36 (2 Chr. 6:27). Lord: therefore will he teach sinners in the way, Ps. 25:8. I will instruct thee and teach thee, Ps. 32:8. I have taught thee in the way of wisdom, Prov. 4:11. teach a just man, and he will increase in learning, Prov. 9:9. Train up a child in the way he should go, Prov. 22:6. he will teach us of his ways, Isa. 2:3 (Micah 4:2; 2 Ne. 12:3). fear toward me is taught by the precept of men, Isa. 29:13 (2 Ne. 27:25; 28:14). thy children shall be taught of the Lord, Isa. 54:13 (John 6:45). teach no more every man his neighbour, Jer. 31:34 (Heb. 8:11). they shall teach my people the difference, Ezek. 44:23. priests thereof teach for hire, Micah 3:11.

Jesus went about … teaching in their synagogues, Matt. 4:23 (9:35; 13:54; Mark 1:21; 6:2; Luke 4:15). break … commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least, Matt. 5:19. he taught them as one having authority, Matt. 7:29 (Mark 1:22). it shall be given you … what ye shall speak, Matt. 10:19. teaching for doctrines the commandments of men, Matt. 15:9 (Mark 7:7). Master, we know that thou … teachest the way of God, Matt. 22:16 (Mark 12:14; Luke 20:21). I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, Matt. 26:55 (Mark 14:49). Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, Matt. 28:19. Teaching them to observe all things, Matt. 28:20. he taught them many things by parables, Mark 4:2. he began to teach them many things, Mark 6:34. Lord, teach us to pray, Luke 11:1. Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour, Luke 12:12. he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath, Luke 13:10. he taught daily in the temple, Luke 19:47. as my Father hath taught me, I speak, John 8:28. Comforter … shall teach you all things, John 14:26 (D&C 75:10). all that Jesus began both to do and teach, Acts 1:1. commanded them not to … teach in the name of Jesus, Acts 4:18. they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ, Acts 5:42. taught diligently the things of the Lord, Acts 18:25. taught according to the perfect manner of the law, Acts 22:3. Thou … which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself, Rom. 2:21. not … which man’s wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth, 1 Cor. 2:13. that by my voice I might teach others also, 1 Cor. 14:19. neither was I taught it, but by the revelation, Gal. 1:12. teaching and admonishing one another in psalms, Col. 3:16. ye … are taught of God, 1 Thes. 4:9. hold the traditions which ye have been taught, 2 Thes. 2:15. charge … that they teach no other doctrine, 1 Tim. 1:3. I suffer not a woman to teach, 1 Tim. 2:12. bishop then must be … apt to teach, 1 Tim. 3:2. These things teach and exhort, 1 Tim. 6:2. men, who shall be able to teach, 2 Tim. 2:2. be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, 2 Tim. 2:24. Holding fast … as he hath been taught, Titus 1:9. teach the young women to be sober, Titus 2:4. ye have need that one teach you again, Heb. 5:12. ye need not that any man teach you, 1 Jn. 2:27.

I was taught somewhat in all the learning of my father, 1 Ne. 1:1. God who teacheth thee to profit, 1 Ne. 20:17. they are sufficient to teach any man the right way, 2 Ne. 25:28. Spirit which teacheth a man to pray, 2 Ne. 32:8. Holy Ghost carrieth it unto the hearts of … men, 2 Ne. 33:1. they teach all men that they should do good, 2 Ne. 33:10. teach them the word of God with all diligence, Jacob 1:19. my father … taught me in his language, Enos 1:1. teach them to walk in the ways of truth, Mosiah 4:15. Lord doth grant unto all nations … to teach his word, Alma 29:8. they had been taught to keep the commandments, Alma 53:21. all thy children shall be taught of the Lord, 3 Ne. 22:13. they should teach the things which he had expounded, 3 Ne. 23:14. Jesus did truly teach unto the people, 3 Ne. 26:6. to one is given … that he may teach the word of wisdom, Moro. 10:9 (D&C 88:118).

Seek not to declare my word, but first seek to obtain my word, D&C 11:21. priest’s duty is to preach, teach, D&C 20:46. Comforter, which shall teach you the peaceable things, D&C 36:2. teach one another according to the office … appointed, D&C 38:23. teach the principles of my gospel, D&C 42:12. if ye receive not the Spirit ye shall not teach, D&C 42:14. not sent forth to be taught, but to teach, D&C 43:15. ye are to be taught from on high, D&C 43:16. Comforter which was sent forth to teach the truth, D&C 50:14. that which is taught them by the Comforter, D&C 52:9. taught through prayer by the Spirit, D&C 63:65. teach them not … the sin be upon the heads of the parents, D&C 68:25. teach their children to pray, and to walk uprightly, D&C 68:28. the Comforter, which shall teach them all things, D&C 75:10. this Moses plainly taught to the children of Israel, D&C 84:23. Father teacheth him of the covenant, D&C 84:48. treasure up … words of life, and it shall be given you, D&C 84:85. teach one another the doctrine, D&C 88:77. Teach ye diligently, D&C 88:78. teach one another words of wisdom, D&C 88:118. You have not taught your children light and truth, D&C 93:42. that my people may be taught more perfectly, D&C 105:10. president over the office of a deacon is to … teach them their duty, D&C 107:85. Savior … endeavoring to teach them, D&C 138:25. These the Lord taught, and gave them power, D&C 138:51.
their children were taught to read and write, Moses 6:6. faith was taught unto the children of men, Moses 6:23. commandment, to teach these things freely, Moses 6:58.
